mapper.insert: insert into User_List (user_id, phone, addr, gender, name, password, email, age) values (#{user_id}, #{phone}, #{addr}, #{gender}, #{name}, #{password}, #{email}, #{age})
mapper.select: select count(*) from User_List where user_id = #{user_id}
select user_id from User_List where name = #{name} and phone = #{phone} and del_yn = 'N' limit 1
select unum from User_List where user_id = #{user_id} and phone = #{phone} and del_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: update User_List set password = #{password} where unum = #{unum}
mapper.select: select * from User_List where user_id = #{user_id} and del_yn = 'N'
select * from User_List where unum = #{unum} and del_yn = 'N'
select name from User_List where unum = #{unum}
mapper.update: update User_List set user_id = concat('deleted_', unum), password = '!', name = '탈퇴회원', phone = '', email = null, addr = null, gender = null, del_yn = 'Y' where unum = #{unum} and del_yn = 'N'
